handback.title: A re-plan and code review keep the owner's commits
handback.summary: Commits the owner pushes to a Dokima branch stay through a re-plan and reach the code review.
handback.user_story: Commits the owner pushes to a Dokima branch stay through a re-plan and reach the code review.

acceptance_criteria.text: A re-plan starts on the branch with the owner's commits still in it.

edge_cases.case: The branch clashes with main, as when main moved under the owner's work.

acceptance_criteria.text: The code review's diff holds the owner's commits on the branch.
acceptance_criteria.words: My work goes through the same reviews and checks as agent work.

edge_cases.case: Main moved on after the branch split off; its change is not shown as the owner's.

raises.label: Doubt: already true
raises.text: Both asks already hold, so the check rejects their new tests. Close this, or allow pinning tests? Plan assumes pinning.
raises.evidence: Both tests in `tests/test_owner_commits_kept.py` pass on main; `passing_today()` in `dokima/planner.py` rejects them.
